card.name: Endings of long drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long generic drug name, just before the name ends or a salt word follows, such as meglumine, deruxtecan, disoproxil, lysine, epolamine.

modes.label: Final piece of antibody-drug names
modes.description: The closing piece of fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan in lists of other trastuzumab products.

modes.label: Salt or base endings
modes.description: The ending piece of a drug name that is a salt or base, such as meglumine, disoproxil, lysine or epolamine.
